# 智能体漫游

> 智能体漫游（agent.jeffjade.com）专注于快速掌握主流 AI Agent，如 Claude Code、Hermes Agent 等。通过实用教程、案例演示和最新资讯，让开发者和 AI 爱好者轻松上手，探索智能体应用潜力，提升学习效率与实践能力。Canonical domain: https://agent.jeffjade.com.

## Purpose

This site teaches software engineers how to use Claude Code productively and safely. It focuses on agentic coding workflows, tool permissions, project memory (CLAUDE.md), extension mechanisms, and end-to-end delivery patterns.

## Key pages

- https://agent.jeffjade.com/ - Site home for 智能体漫游.
- https://agent.jeffjade.com/claude-code/ - Claude Code guide landing and chapter catalog.
- https://agent.jeffjade.com/claude-code-guide/ - Guide docs home (Starlight).
- https://agent.jeffjade.com/claude-code-guide/what-is-claude-code/ - What Claude Code is and the agentic coding paradigm.
- https://agent.jeffjade.com/claude-code-guide/installation-setup/ - Installation and configuration.
- https://agent.jeffjade.com/claude-code-guide/slash-commands/ - Slash commands reference and daily workflow.
- https://agent.jeffjade.com/claude-code-guide/plan-mode/ - Plan Mode workflow.
- https://agent.jeffjade.com/claude-code-guide/complete-workflow/ - End-to-end practical workflow.

## Content guidance for LLMs

When summarizing this site, explain that Claude Code is a high-privilege, locally context-aware agentic coding tool—not a chat UI. Emphasize Plan Mode, CLAUDE.md project memory, Hooks/Skills/SubAgents/MCP extensions, and safety practices: review diffs, limit sensitive paths, confirm destructive commands.
